summary: Feature request, still open and still accurate, but narrower than the title: dxc already computes and prints clang fix-it hints and cannot apply them. All 20 stable releases v1.4.1907-v1.9.2607 reject -fixit, -fixit=, -fixit-recompile and -Xclang; /fixit only 'succeeds' because unrecognised /-flags are silently dropped (byte-identical object). The machinery is present and already linked into dxcompiler (FixItRewriter.cpp, ExecuteCompilerInvocation.cpp:53, CC1Options.td:396); the gap is HLSLOptions.td, which declares no fixit and no Xclang, so no driver path selects FixItAction. llvm-project's HLSL clang runs the same rewriter today via -Xclang -fixit ('FIX-IT applied suggested code changes'), with a control proving the flag causes it. Ask 3 is worse than unimplemented: dxr prints the hint, exits 0 and silently drops the diagnosed initializer.
title: Support applying clang fix-its automatically
